paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 4.97 as of 2026-09-04, with a 2.37 percent increase from the prior close and a 21.16 percent decrease over the last 24 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. is in the news due to Burford Brothers Inc. taking a position in the company, purchasing 294,416 shares during the 2nd quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing. This news was reported by MarketBeat on 2026-09-04.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including forms 3, 8-K, 4, and 10-Q, with the most recent being a form 3 filed on 2026-09-03. Insider transaction reports were filed on 2026-08-27 and 2026-08-18, and the company has scheduled its first annual meeting of stockholders for October 30, 2026.
